hook: How to read the expected move before NVDA (Nvidia) earnings.
caption: How to read the expected move before NVDA (Nvidia) earnings. NVDA reports earnings Tuesday, Nov 17, after the close. On Friday, Nov 13, it closed at $162.85. Look at the $162.50 call and the $162.50 put that both expire Friday, Nov 20, three trading days after the report. At Friday's close the call's mid was $8.05 and the put's was $7.65. Together that's $15.70 a share. That's roughly the move the options market is pricing in, up or down: about 10%, or about $147 to $179. That's why these options cost so much right now. The $165 call expiring Nov 20 had an implied volatility of 86%. The same strike expiring Dec 17, 2027 had 47%. After the report the big unknown is gone, and implied volatility usually drops fast. That's called IV crush. So a call bought before earnings can lose money even if NVDA goes up, when the move is small. The $162.50 call at $8.05 breaks even at $170.55 at expiration.
